pages.text: Burns Techguns nuclear micro reactors. $(b)400 FE/t$(); one micro reactor gives 4,800,000 FE (10 minutes). The depleted reactor goes to the second slot.
It heats up while running. Water on any side cools it faster than it heats. Without water it overheats in about a minute and stops until it has cooled to half. The heat bar is in its window.
pages.title: Cooling

pages.text: Exploding on overheating is off by default; nuclearGeneratorExplodes in techguns-common.toml turns it on. With the radiation system enabled, a running generator irradiates everyone within 4 blocks.
pages.title: Danger
